narrative.intro: Moeve S A recorded $274M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Moeve S A won 17 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $16.1M, and obligations are up 108.0% year over year. The company’s obligations have moved through several annual levels: $69.8M in FY21, $107M in FY22, $215M in FY23, $158M in FY24, $132M in FY25, and $274M in FY26. The FY2026 to date total is a partial, fiscal year to date figure. These totals are contract obligations except where award values are explicitly noted as total contract values in the underlying award tables. Readers should treat the current-year totals as partial because FY2026 is not complete. The sequence of annual obligations shows the firm’s federal receipts rising and falling across fiscal years before the current-year increase to $274M. Use these exact figures when comparing Moeve S A to peers, or when preparing briefings that require firm, auditable numbers for FY2026 to date.
